discussion_comments.comment_body: Add *Omit `opts` to use a default value of `false`* and explain what difference it makes.

I'm guessing I'm not explaining it very well but what I was trying to get at is that the example should be
```js
const fn = data => console.log(data);
const hub = createEventHub();

hub.on('message', fn); // subscribe the handler to listen for 'message' events
hub.emit('message', { hello: 'world' }); // logs the object
hub.emit('message', 'hello world' }); // logs 'hello world'
hub.off('message', fn); // unsubscribe the handler from 'message' events
```

I've seen so many developer not understand that the type passed to the event handler is whatever is passed to the event. I'm not sure why I've seen it so many times, but I have enough that it should be here

after all an event can be more than just a string or an object
